title: nf-metro theme
description: A theme file: top-level fields apply to both palettes, `light:` and `dark:` to one each.

extends.description: Themes stacked before this one: a name, a theme file relative to this file, or a list of them.

fixed_mode.description: Render one palette, in this mode, whatever mode is asked for; `none` clears a fixed mode set earlier in the stack.

light.description: Fields for the light palette only.

dark.description: Fields for the dark palette only.

section_x_padding.description: Space between a section's box and its stations along x.

section_y_padding.description: Space between a section's box and its stations along y.

track_gap.description: Gap in px between adjacent strokes in a bundle.

row_align.description: Section bbox sizing within a grid row.

center_ports.description: Centre inter-section ports on the shorter section.

compact_offsets.description: Size each station for the lines passing through it.

label_angle.description: Station label angle in degrees (0 = horizontal).

label_offset.description: Gap between a station marker and its label.

diagonal_run.description: Length of the 45-degree transition between two tracks.

font_scale.description: Scale text sizes and label metrics.

stroke_scale.description: Scale stroke weight and station pill size.

logo_scale.description: Scale the logo, in the legend block or standalone.

legend_min_height.description: Minimum legend content height in px.

legend_logo_gap.description: Gap in px between the logo and the legend entries.

directional.description: Draw chevrons showing each route's flow direction.

layout.description: Layout options, below `%%metro` directives and command-line flags.

background_color.description: Canvas fill. `none` leaves the canvas transparent.

label_font_family.description: CSS font stack for station labels, and for every other text element.

label_font_size.description: Station label size, px. Layout reserves label room from the map's own settings, so keep this near 13 and use the `font_scale` layout option to grow text.

label_halo_width.description: Width of the knockout halo behind station labels, px. 0 disables it.

label_halo_color.description: Halo colour. Empty takes the background, or white on a transparent canvas.

caption_color.description: `%%metro caption:` text, in colours that follow the viewer's light or dark mode. Empty draws a fixed light grey.

canvas_padding.description: Margin around the map on every side, px.

section_fill.description: Section box fill. `transparent` draws an outline only.

section_label_letter_spacing.description: Extra space between section title letters, px.

section_stroke_dasharray.description: SVG dash pattern for the section outline (`2 4`). Empty is solid.

section_badges.description: Draw the numbered circle beside each section title. Off, titles start where the badge would be.

group_rule_width.description: Width of the rule under a station group's caption, px.

group_rule_opacity.description: Opacity of the rule under a station group's caption, 0 to 1.

legend_stroke.description: Legend box outline. Empty draws none.

legend_stroke_width.description: Legend outline width, px. 0 draws none.

legend_padding.description: Space inside the legend box, px.

legend_line_height.description: Height of each legend row, px.

legend_swatch_width.description: Length of each line swatch, px.

marker_stroke.description: Outline of `%%metro marker:` glyphs and their legend swatches. Empty takes `station_stroke`.

marker_open_fill.description: Inside of `open` markers. Empty takes the background, or white on a transparent canvas.

glyph_stroke.description: Outline of interchange rings and their links, the `bar` terminus, and station capsules, in colours that follow the viewer's light or dark mode. Empty takes `station_stroke`, and capsules keep it in both modes.

ring_fill.description: Inside of interchange rings and the strip bridging a chain of them. Empty takes the background, or white on a transparent canvas.

station_glyph.description: How a station on one line is drawn. `pill` draws a capsule. `tick` draws a tab in the line's colour on the label's side, and a bar across the line's end (a buffer stop) at a terminus.

interchange_glyph.description: How a station on several lines is drawn. `pill` draws a capsule across them. `ring` draws one ring centred on the lines, or a chain of touching rings bridged by a strip when the lines are too wide for one.

station_stroke.description: Station capsule outline; also the default marker and file-icon outline.

capsule_fill.description: Inside of station capsules and interchanges, in colours that follow the viewer's light or dark mode. Empty takes `station_fill` in both modes.

terminus_glyph.description: How a line end shared by several lines is drawn. `nub` is a square-cornered box across the lines in the station colours; `bar` is a buffer-stop bar across the whole bundle, as thick as a tab and overhanging the outermost lines by a tab's length; `ring` draws the interchange glyph. A line end with one line follows `station_glyph`.

station_tick_width.description: Thickness of a `tick` tab along its line, and of a terminus bar, in multiples of `line_width`.

station_tick_length.description: How far a `tick` tab reaches past the edge of its line, and how far a terminus bar overhangs each side, in multiples of `line_width`.

ring_inner_diameter.description: Inside diameter of an interchange ring, in multiples of `line_width`.

ring_stroke_width.description: Interchange ring outline width, in multiples of `line_width`.

ring_bridge_width.description: Width of the strip bridging a chain of rings, in multiples of `line_width`.

ring_max_lines.description: Most lines on one track a single ring of `ring_inner_diameter` covers; a wider bundle follows `ring_overflow`.

ring_overflow.description: What a bundle wider than `ring_max_lines` gets: `chain`, a bridged chain of rings, or `grow`, one ring whose inside widens to cover it.

line_cap.description: End caps of route strokes: `round` or `butt`.

dashed_dasharray.description: SVG dash pattern of a `dashed` line.

dotted_dasharray.description: SVG dash pattern of a `dotted` line.

bridge_gap.description: Gap a line leaves either side of a line it hops over, px.

muted_line_color.description: Grey for inactive lines and the stations, labels and icons only they touch. A two-palette SVG switches it with the viewer's mode.

bridge_glyph.description: Break the lower line where two unrelated lines cross.

directional_marker_spacing.description: Distance between chevrons along a route, px.

directional_marker_color.description: Chevron colour. Empty takes the line's colour.

terminus_fold_size.description: Size of the folded corner, px.

icon_banner_fill.description: Fill of the band across a file icon.

icon_banner_text_color.description: File type text on the icon band.

terminus_font_size.description: Size of the format label inside the icon, px.

terminus_font_color.description: Format label colour. Empty takes the built-in dark ink.
